actionable_steps.citation: Chant the Name of God and Experience Divinity — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-04-30
actionable_steps.step: From dawn to dusk, do your duty with the firm conviction that all duties belong to God — do it with love.

actionable_steps.citation: Removal Of Immorality Is The Only Way To Immortality — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-04-10
actionable_steps.step: Perform your duty without craving the fruits; leave the results to God.
Do your duty with love, as if you were adoring God thereby — duty without love is deplorable.

actionable_steps.citation: Purity - The Path To Divinity — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-01-01
actionable_steps.step: Put duty before display — serve the person in front of you first; devotion that neglects duty is mere show.
Concentrate on your duty in the present moment — do not fret over the past or the future.

definition.citation: Purity - The Path To Divinity — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-01-01
definition.quote: Duty is God. Work is Worship... Your first duty is to look after the patient. Your devotion will be mere show if you leave the patient in the lurch and go for Svami's dharshan.

discourses.quote: Duty is God, that is the lesson the Ramayana teaches... Duty is the responsibility you have to respect and revere others and to serve them to the best of your ability.

discourses.citation: Purity, patience, perseverance: steps to Divinity — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-11-23
discourses.quote: Do your duty. Duty is God. Work is worship. When you perform your duties, you will be acquiring the title to your rights.

discourses.citation: Removal Of Immorality Is The Only Way To Immortality — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-04-10
discourses.quote: It is your duty to perform actions. Duty is very important. Your responsibility is only to perform your duty; you have no authority on rights.

discourses.citation: The predicament of man today — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-01-21
discourses.quote: You have the right to perform your duty only. You have no right to demand the fruits of your action. No one has got any right other than doing his duty.

make_it_real: Duty is God, work is worship — do today's duty as if you were serving Him directly. You are.
title: Duty

vahinis.quote: It is only in the duty (karma) that is your very nature that you can have fortitude; if it is just an assumed duty, you will find it difficult to put up with troubles and travails. Assumed duty will induce conceit, or the feeling 'I am the doer', so it will result in exhaustion or elation, disgust or pride.
